description:
Senior Sales Manager Gold Loan | Rupeek Location: Mumbai
 Coverage: Churchgate to Dadar | Dadar to Borivali | Kurla to Thane
 Industry: FinTech / NBFC / BFSI / Lending
 Role: Senior Sales Manager – Gold Loan
 Employment Type: Full-Time Build Your Next Career Move in Gold Lending Are you an experienced BFSI sales professional working in CASA, Home Loans, Personal Loans, Business Loans, LAP, Mortgage, Credit Cards, Retail Assets or any other lending product ? Are you strong in sales, customer acquisition, relationship management and business development — but have never worked in Gold Loans? That is absolutely fine. At Rupeek , we are looking for high-performing sales professionals who are willing to enter and build their career in the rapidly growing Gold Loan industry . Prior Gold Loan experience is not mandatory for the right candidate. What matters most is your: Sales capability Customer acquisition experience Target orientation Relationship-building ability Local market knowledge Business development mindset Ability and willingness to learn Candidates demonstrating strong learning capability can be trained on Gold Loan processes, Gold Valuation and Gold Appraisal fundamentals , helping them build expertise in the gold-lending business. Who Should Apply? We are looking for candidates with experience in: CASA Sales Home Loan Sales Personal Loan Sales Business Loan Sales Loan Against Property – LAP Mortgage Sales Retail Asset Sales Banking Sales NBFC Sales FinTech Sales Credit Card Sales SME / Business Banking Branch Banking Sales Field Sales / Direct Sales Relationship Management If you have successfully handled customers, generated business and achieved sales targets in BFSI, we want to speak with you. Key Responsibilities Drive customer acquisition and Gold Loan business within the assigned Mumbai market. Generate business through field activities, referrals, existing networks and local market development. Build strong relationships with customers and identify their financial requirements. Manage leads from initial contact through conversion. Drive business through customer referrals and repeat customers. Develop strong catchment-level market presence. Conduct regular sales activities and customer engagement initiatives. Work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and loan processing. Achieve assigned monthly and quarterly business targets. Maintain strong customer relationships for renewals and repeat business. Identify new business opportunities within the assigned territory. Develop deeper understanding of Gold Loan products and customer requirements. Learn Gold Valuation and Gold Appraisal processes as required for the role. Maintain high standards of customer service and compliance. What Makes You a Strong Fit? You are someone who: Loves sales and enjoys meeting customers. Has a strong record of achieving business targets. Understands the local Mumbai market. Is comfortable with field sales and customer acquisition. Can build a strong referral network. Is willing to learn a new lending product. Wants to move into the Gold Loan / secured lending business. Is interested in building a long-term career in FinTech and Financial Services. Gold Loan Experience Is NOT Mandatory We specifically welcome professionals from other BFSI products who are willing to learn. You may currently be working as: Senior Sales Manager, Sales Manager, Relationship Manager, Relationship Officer, Branch Sales Manager, Business Development Manager, Home Loan Sales Manager, Personal Loan Sales Manager, CASA Sales Manager, Loan Officer, Territory Sales Manager, Sales Officer, Business Banking Relationship Manager, Retail Asset Manager or Mortgage Sales Manager. If you have the sales mindset and learning capability , we can help you understand the Gold Loan business, including the basics of Gold Valuation and Gold Appraisal . Mumbai Hiring Locations We are hiring across the complete Mumbai market, including: South Mumbai: Churchgate, Marine Lines, Charni Road, Grant Road, Mumbai Central, Mahalaxmi, Lower Parel, Prabhadevi, Dadar Western Line: Dadar, Mahim, Bandra, Khar, Santacruz, Vile Parle, Andheri, Jogeshwari, Goregaon, Malad, Kandivali, Borivali Central Line: Kurla, Vidyavihar, Ghatkopar, Vikhroli, Kanjurmarg, Bhandup, Nahur, Mulund, Thane Candidates staying within or comfortable travelling across these locations are encouraged to apply. Why Rupeek? This is an opportunity to take your existing BFSI sales experience and enter a specialized lending segment where you can develop additional expertise in: Gold Lending | Customer Acquisition | Relationship Management | Secured Lending | Gold Valuation | Gold Appraisal | Business Development If you are currently performing well in CASA, Home Loans, Personal Loans or any other lending product but are looking for a new challenge and a larger learning opportunity , this could be your next move. Your current product does not define your future. Your sales ability does. Apply if you are serious about sales, open to learning Gold Loans and ready to take ownership of your market.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Job Description: Regional Sales Manager Company: AV Modular India Private Limited Location: Designated Zones / Regions within Maharashtra (Local candidates preferred) Role Type: Full-Time About AV Modular At AV Modular, we are committed to delivering high-quality electrical solutions. As we rapidly expand our footprint across Maharashtra, we are looking for a highly driven sales and on-ground marketing leader to spearhead our regional growth, build our retail presence, and onboard strategic partners. The Role We are seeking an aggressive, results-oriented Regional/Territory Sales Manager (or Chief Sales Executive) to drive our B2B expansion. This is a heavily on-the-ground, field-marketing role focused on going store-to-store, promoting AV Modular products, and getting our brand on the shelves. A core expectation of this position is your ability to build a team to work alongside you and drive this expansion. Your ultimate goal is to maximise brand penetration, onboard the right partners, and increase overall ROI in your designated zone. Key Responsibilities Retail & Dealer Onboarding: Execute aggressive on-ground marketing by visiting shops, electrical counters, and stores to pitch and onboard them. Note: By "dealer," we specifically mean partners who sell products directly to consumers or distribute to local retailers. Team Building & Leadership: Develop a team from the ground up. You will lead this team on the ground, setting clear targets and routing plans to maximise shelf space and market share. Network Expansion: Build, nurture, and manage a vast network of dealers, retailers, and shops across your specific local region or district. Strategic Management Reporting: Maintain continuous, holistic communication with organisational higher management. This goes beyond merely passing along messages; you will be expected to provide comprehensive updates on market situations, on-ground developments, daily challenges, competitor activities, policy feedback, and field events. B2B Relationship Management: Negotiate terms, secure shelf placements, and ensure consistent inventory movement for our product catalogues. ROI & Revenue Growth: Take ownership of regional sales quotas and implement strategies to ensure a high return on investment for the territory. Candidate Priorities & Experience Requirements We prioritize candidates based on the following backgrounds: Priority 1: Direct sales and dealer management experience in Electrical Accessories (switches, face plates, sockets, and related side items). Priority 2: Experience in overall general Electrical Industry Sales and Distribution . Priority 3: Experience in plumbing and hardware Sales and Distribution . Priority 4: Candidates lacking the specific industry backgrounds above but possessing an exceptional, proven track record in B2B Sales Expansion, specifically in aggressively onboarding dealers, retailers, and shops to put new brands on shelves. What You Bring to the Table Exceptional on-ground hustle, capability, and a deep understanding of local market dynamics. The ability to develop a dedicated on-ground sales team. Ability to communicate the value, quality, and margins of AV Modular products effectively. Willingness to travel within your designated zones or parts of Maharashtra (being a local of the region you will be working in is a major advantage).

 Note: We value capability and market knowledge over formal tenure. If you do not have years of formal experience on paper, but you possess the raw capability, drive, and deep knowledge of this market and field, we still want you to apply.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
About us 
We are Powerplay, Indias 1st mobile app for construction. In simple words, its the "Slack for Construction Industry". It replaces WhatsApp groups and helps the contractors to collect money faster by improving their site to office communication. Founded by IIT Roorkee alumni - Iesh Dixit and Shubham Goyal. Backed by industry experts and leading VCs like Sequoia, Accel, and India Quotient. About The Role Powerplay has built a successful business by selling remotely to over 2,000 paying customers across India. Now, we're building our offline sales motion and we're looking for our Founding Account Executive - Field Sales in Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, This is our first field sales hire . There is no existing playbook, territory strategy, or proven sales motion. You'll work closely with the Business Head and Founders to figure out what works, document it, and help define how Powerplay builds and scales offline sales. What You'll Own New customer acquisition across General Contractors (GCs) in your assigned Bangalore territory, from prospecting to deal closure. A monthly and quarterly revenue target. Relationships with Owners, Founders, Directors, Project Heads, and Management Teams within the General Contracting ecosystem. CRM discipline and a forecast we can rely on, we’d much rather get bad news early. The field sales playbook that future offline expansion hires will be trained on. What Your Week Looks Like Three or four in-person meetings a day. Site offices, builders' offices, project sites. You will spend more time in traffic than at a desk. Meetings with the owner or MD, not a procurement executive. Explaining why a mobile-first product does the job better than the 15 lakh ERP quote sitting on their table, and why "we already use WhatsApp" is the problem they called you about. Walking a site before you pitch, so you understand how the team really works. Feeding what you hear back to a product team that will do something with it. Writing down what worked and what didn't. Every week. What We're Looking For Must Have Requirements 3 - 8 years of B2B Field Sales experience with a proven track record of achieving sales targets. Experience selling directly to Owners, Founders, Directors, or other senior business decision-makers. Comfortable spending most of your time in the field, including construction sites. Fluent in English , Hindi and regional Language Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Experience managing the complete sales cycle independently.

Key Skills: Software sales,End To End Sales,Sales executive activities,SAAS Sales,Demonstration,Software,Field sales,Generation

The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing relationships with industrial customers, understanding customer requirements, presenting technically suitable solutions, preparing commercial proposals and converting opportunities into orders.
The role requires a combination of sales ability, technical understanding, customer relationship management and strong follow-up skills .

 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business Development & Lead Generation 
 Identify and develop new customers through field visits, cold calling, references, networking, digital channels and industry contacts. Generate leads from industries, consultants, EPC companies, OEMs, system integrators, government organisations and institutional customers. Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline. Conduct regular customer visits and identify upcoming projects and business opportunities. Understand customer pain points and convert them into potential business opportunities. 
 2. Product & Solution Sales 
Depending upon the assigned business segment, the salesperson will handle sales of:
 Water & Wastewater Solutions 
 STP Sewage Treatment Plants Water recycling and reuse solutions -ZLD & RO Systems Demineralization systems and water softners Wastewater treatment and process-water solutions Water Treatment Chemicals (Manufacturing) 
 Boiler water treatment chemicals Cooling water treatment chemicals RO Antiscalant chemicals Polyelectrolytes Microbiological Solutions Drop water testing kits Automated dosing and online monitoring solutions Environmental Monitoring & Analytical Solutions 
 RTWQMS Real Time Water Quality Monitoring Systems based on UV- Vis spectral scanning and High temperature oxidization based on TOC measurement. CEMS Continuous Emission Monitoring Systems based on NDUV/NDIR/UV-DOAS/TDLAS for gas Analyzers and forward and backward light scattering for dust measurement. CAAQMS Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Systems- USEPA approved analytical solutions as per NAAQS 2009 under the gazette of India. Gas Detection for 100+ gases based on NDIR/ Pellister/EC/PID/Solid state sensors with ATEX, IECEx, MED and SIL2. IAQ Indoor Air Quality Monitoring PM10 / PM2.5 monitoring systems based on Beta Ray attenuation and light scattering. Radar and Ultrasonic Level, Velocity and Volume monitoring solutions. Environmental IoT & Software Solutions 
 Environmental data acquisition systems IoT-based monitoring Cloud dashboards Real-time environmental monitoring Alerts and notifications Compliance reporting CPCB / SPCB-oriented environmental monitoring solutions 
 3. Customer & Relationship Management 
 Build strong relationships with Plant Heads, EHS/Environment Heads, Purchase Managers, Maintenance Heads, Project Heads, Consultants and Management. Understand the customer's existing system, technical requirements, budget and project timelines. Maintain regular communication with existing and prospective customers. Develop repeat business and cross-selling opportunities. 
 4. Technical Sales & Solution Development 
 Understand customer applications and recommend appropriate products or solutions. Coordinate with the technical/service/engineering team for site surveys and technical discussions. Arrange product demonstrations, presentations and technical meetings. Prepare or coordinate technical and commercial proposals. Explain product features, benefits, ROI and compliance advantages to customers. Participate in negotiations and assist in closing orders. 
 5. Project & Order Follow-up 
 Follow up on quotations and proposals until closure. Coordinate internally after receipt of purchase orders. Maintain proper communication between customer, sales, service, engineering and management teams. Track order execution, installation, commissioning and customer satisfaction. Identify opportunities for AMC, consumables, chemicals, service and additional equipment. 
 
 6. Market Development 
 Study competitors, market prices, products and customer requirements. Identify new industries and geographical markets. Track upcoming industrial projects and environmental compliance requirements. Develop new territories and customer segments. Build relationships with consultants, EPC contractors, environmental consultants and channel partners. 
 7. Reporting 
 Maintain daily/weekly sales activity reports. Update leads, opportunities, quotations and follow-ups in the company's CRM/system. Submit monthly sales forecasts. Maintain customer database and project pipeline. Report market feedback, competitor activities and new opportunities to management. 

 Target Customers / Industries 
The candidate may be required to develop business in:
 Manufacturing Industries Automobile & Auto Components Pharmaceutical Industries Chemical Industries Textile Industries Food & Beverage Industries Paper & Pulp Industries Dairy Industries Sugar Industries Petrochemical & Oil & Gas Power Plants Metals & Steel Electroplating Industries Hospitals Hotels Commercial Buildings Industrial Parks STPs / CETPs Municipal & Government Projects Infrastructure Projects Educational Institutions Corporate Campuses 
 
 Key Customer Contacts 
The candidate should be comfortable interacting with:
 Plant Head Factory Head EHS / Environment Head Maintenance Head Utility Head Project Head Purchase / Procurement Team Engineering Team Instrumentation Team Pollution Control / Compliance Teams Consultants EPC Contractors System Integrators Government / PSU Officials Senior Management 
 Eligibility & Qualifications 
 Education: 
 B.Tech / B.E. / Diploma in Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or related engineering field preferred. B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Environmental Science, Chemistry or related field may also be considered for relevant sales roles. Candidates with strong B2B industrial sales experience may also be considered irrespective of exact technical specialization. 
 Experience: 
 28 years of relevant B2B sales experience preferred. Experience in industrial water treatment, wastewater treatment, environmental monitoring, analytical instruments, instrumentation, chemicals, IoT, automation or industrial equipment will be an advantage. 
 Required Skills 
 Strong B2B sales and business development skills Excellent communication and presentation skills Technical understanding and ability to learn technical products Good negotiation and closing skills Strong customer relationship management Lead generation and prospecting ability Good follow-up discipline Ability to understand technical requirements Ability to prepare and explain quotations/proposals Willingness to travel for customer visits Good knowledge of MS Office CRM knowledge will be an advantage Strong commercial understanding Target-oriented approach 
 
 Preferred Experience 
Candidates with experience in any of the following sectors will be preferred:

 Personal Attributes

 Responsibilities

 What we are looking for 
 
 Essential 
 03 years in outbound calling, international sales, or a US voice process Clear, confident spoken English and a neutral accent that US customers understand easily Genuine resilience the ability to be told no repeatedly and pick up the phone again Strong listening skills; able to ask a second and third question rather than reciting a pitch Comfortable working a permanent night shift from our Noida office Basic comfort with CRM tools and everyday digital software Graduate in any discipline English fluency sufficient to hold an unscripted business conversation with a US decision-maker

 Who tends to do well here 
 People who are curious about a strangers business rather than eager to talk about ours People who treat a "no" as information, not as a verdict on them People who want to be coached and will act on feedback within the week

Identify and engage potential clients, including Founders, CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and other technology decision-makers. Build a strong sales pipeline and consistently achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets. Develop account-specific sales strategies to convert prospects into paying customers. Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, and engagement models while maintaining healthy deal margins. Build long-term client relationships to generate repeat business, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities. 2. Outbound Lead Generation & Pipeline Development Independently identify target companies, industries, and decision-makers for business development. Generate qualified leads through LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, cold emails, cold calls, and other outbound channels. Research client business needs, technology environments, growth plans, and potential outsourcing requirements. Schedule qualified sales meetings and convert them into active sales opportunities. Maintain an updated CRM with lead status, opportunity value, follow-ups, sales forecasts, and closure timelines. 3. Collaborate with technical teams, solution architects, and subject matter experts to develop relevant technology solutions. Prepare and present capability decks, sales presentations, solution proposals, use cases, and commercial estimates. Lead client presentations and solution walkthroughs, clearly communicating business value, technical feasibility, and expected outcomes. Coordinate RFI/RFP responses, requirement clarification, scope definition, and proposal preparation. Map client requirements to Vinove’s service offerings and develop compelling value propositions to improve conversion rates. Support technical and commercial discussions throughout the sales cycle until successful deal closure. 4. Technology Services & Client Engagement Drive sales across relevant service offerings, including: Custom Software and Product Development Web and Mobile Application Development AI/ML and Generative AI Solutions Cloud, Data Engineering, and Analytics Digital Transformation and Workflow Automation IT Staff Augmentation and Dedicated Development Teams Engage effectively with business and technical stakeholders to identify opportunities and position the right services based on client requirements.

Hands-on experience in pre-sales, solution presentations, proposal development, and commercial negotiations. Ability to understand client requirements and translate them into suitable technology solutions. Experience engaging CXOs, Founders, CTOs, CIOs, and other senior stakeholders. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills. Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, CRM tools, and sales intelligence platforms. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience selling to international clients, particularly in the US, UK, and European markets. Manage OEM Marketing Development Funds (MDF) and ensure effective deployment to generate measurable business impact. Collaborate with partner organisations to develop joint value propositions, customer references, and industry-specific solutions. Track and improve partner-sourced and partner-influenced marketing performance. Establish marketing analytics frameworks with visibility into pipeline creation, campaign effectiveness, customer engagement, and ROI. Leverage market intelligence, customer insights, and competitive analysis to support business decision-making. Monitor evolving industry trends in private wireless, Industry 4.0, industrial IoT, cybersecurity, and critical communications. Improve marketing ROI visibility through analytics, reporting, and attribution frameworks. Build a high-performing marketing team with clear capabilities, accountability, and growth plans. The type of transactions we currently work on range from multifamily apartment complexes to large office towers in the United States and European markets, and range in value sizes from $10 million USD - $200+ million USD.

 Required Qualifications -5+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, finance, or related roles. -3+ years of hands-on FPA experience (budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, management reporting) -Real estate industry experience (development, investment, property management, REIT, or real estate advisory). -Advanced Excel proficiency (must-have): complex formulas, INDEX/MATCH or XLOOKUP, pivot tables, scenario and sensitivity tools, dynamic financial -models, and data cleaning at scale. -Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on ambiguous problems. -Solid grasp of financial statements, accounting principles, and real estate metrics (NOI, cap rate, IRR, equity multiple, DSCR, etc.). -Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to non-finance stakeholders. -Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field. 
 Preferred Qualifications -MBA, CFA, CA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification. -Experience with real estate and ERP systems (Yardi, MRI, Argus, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite). -Experience with BI and planning tools (Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, Adaptive Insights) 
 Key Competencies -Attention to detail and a high standard of accuracy -Ownership and accountability -Structured thinking and sound business judgment -Ability to prioritize and manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment -Collaborative, proactive, and curious mindset

description:
Job description Job Title 
 Sales And Marketing Executive

 Job Summary 
We are looking for a Sales And Marketing Executive who has good experience in converting potential leads into clients and can provide end-to-end services to our clients as per requirements.
The candidate should have excellent communication skills. Having prior experience in the finance sector (investment and wealth management) is an added bonus.

Knowledge of mutual funds, insurance and financial planning is preferred, but not mandatory; training is provided.  Onboard new clients who come to us to start their wealth management journey. Carry out investor profiling, risk profiling and financial analysis for each client. Build goal-based plans for each client and track their progress towards those goals. Prepare investment and insurance plans suited to each clients needs. Conduct regular, in-depth portfolio reviews and recommend changes where needed. Take end-to-end ownership of each clients wealth management journey and their progress towards their goals. 
 Location 
 Kolkata
 What We Are Offering Pay that meets or exceeds market standards for your experience and skills. Generous rewards every six months, based on your performance and contribution. A well-defined career path, with continued support to move up the career ladder. No targets to chase, so the focus stays on doing each task well. Comprehensive medical cover, with benefits that go well beyond a standard policy. A respectful environment where team members help one another grow together. We provide laptops, phones, etc. and also provide reimbursements for phone bills, internet bills, travel reimbursement etc. as per the job requirements. We provide Provident Fund, Earned Leaves, Leave Encashment etc.

title: Digital Marketing Project Coordinator
description:
Job Summary 
 Our Make Web Media is looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Digital Marketing Project Coordinator to manage client communication and coordinate with internal teams for the smooth execution of digital marketing projects. The candidate will be responsible for client onboarding, understanding project requirements, coordinating with Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, Graphic Design and Website Development teams, tracking project progress, managing deadlines, handling client queries and ensuring timely project delivery. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication, organizational and follow-up skills, along with a basic understanding of digital marketing and the ability to manage multiple client accounts efficiently. 
 Role & responsibilities 
 1. Client Communication & Relationship Management Communicate with clients regularly to understand their requirements, expectations and feedback. Handle client calls, WhatsApp communication and emails professionally. Collect content requirements, approvals, feedback, images, videos and other necessary inputs from clients. Share updates regarding ongoing activities, deliverables and pending approvals. Maintain professional relationships with clients and ensure timely responses to their queries. 2. Internal Team Coordination Coordinate between clients, digital marketing executives, graphic designers and other internal departments. Communicate client requirements clearly to the concerned team members. Follow up on pending tasks, creatives, content approvals and campaign-related requirements. Ensure that deliverables are completed within the agreed timelines. Track daily tasks and maintain proper records of client communication and work progress. 3. Content Planning & Creation Plan monthly social media content calendars for clients. Create engaging and relevant content for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and other social media platforms. Write captions, social media posts, ad copies, headlines and promotional content. Develop content ideas for static posts, carousels, reels and video creatives. Understand client businesses and prepare content according to their target audience, brand positioning and marketing objectives. Coordinate with graphic designers and video editors to get creatives developed. 4. Social Media & Digital Marketing Coordination Coordinate social media posting schedules and ensure timely publishing. Follow up on content approvals and pending creative requirements. Monitor social media deliverables and maintain monthly content trackers. Support the digital marketing team with campaign content, client inputs and creative requirements. Prepare basic client updates and activity reports. 5. Reporting & Task Management Maintain client-wise task trackers and content calendars. Ensure all client requirements and feedback are documented. Monitor pending tasks and proactively follow up with the concerned team members. Escalate delays, client concerns and execution-related issues to management. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 1-3 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Client Servicing, Social Media Management or a similar role. Good written and verbal communication skills. Strong content writing and copywriting abilities. Understanding of Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and other social media platforms. Ability to plan social media content calendars and generate creative content ideas. Comfortable communicating with clients through calls, WhatsApp and emails. Good coordination, follow-up and task management skills. Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously. Proficiency in Google Sheets, Google Docs, MS Office and basic digital marketing tools. Knowledge of creative concepts will be an added advantage. Strong ownership, attention to detail and professional communication are essential.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
WE'RE HIRING: INFLUENCER MARKETING MANAGER (Immediate Joiner) 
 About the Opportunity We are not looking for someone who simply finds influencers. We are looking for someone who can independently build, develop and lead an entire Influencer Marketing function for a growing UK-focused furniture and home brand. 
 Dream Home Store (DHS) is looking for an experienced Influencer Marketing Manager who understands how to turn creator partnerships into meaningful brand awareness, qualified website traffic and measurable business growth. This is an ownership-driven opportunity. You will be responsible for developing the strategy, identifying the right creators, building relationships, executing campaigns, managing budgets and tracking results. 
 You will have the opportunity to build the function from the ground up and take responsibility for its overall performance. Key Responsibilities 
 1. Market Research & Strategy Conduct detailed research on the UK influencer marketing landscape, particularly within furniture, home dcor, interiors and lifestyle categories. Research competitors, their influencer strategies, creator partnerships and campaign activities. Identify emerging creators, audience trends and new collaboration opportunities. Develop and continuously improve DHS's influencer marketing strategy. 
 2. Influencer Discovery & Relationship Management Identify, research and shortlist relevant UK-based influencers and content creators. Evaluate creators based on audience demographics, authenticity, engagement quality, content relevance and brand suitability. Build and maintain a structured influencer database. Independently approach creators, negotiate commercial terms and establish long-term partnerships. Develop relationships with micro, mid-tier and larger influencers. 
 3. Campaign Planning & Execution Plan and execute influencer campaigns from concept to completion. Develop campaign briefs, content guidelines, collaboration proposals and deliverables. Manage paid collaborations, product gifting, sponsored content, UGC and brand ambassador initiatives. Coordinate product selection, campaign timelines, content approvals and publishing schedules. Ensure campaigns align with DHS's brand identity and marketing objectives. Ensure relevant UK advertising disclosure requirements are followed. 
 4. Affiliate Marketing & Sales Growth Develop influencer-led affiliate and performance-based collaboration opportunities. Manage promotional codes, tracking links and affiliate partnerships. Identify opportunities to generate qualified website traffic and sales through creator partnerships. Coordinate with internal teams to improve campaign conversion performance. Develop repeat collaboration opportunities with high-performing creators. 
 5. Budget Management & Performance Analysis Plan and manage influencer marketing budgets. Negotiate competitive collaboration rates and evaluate campaign costs. Monitor reach, engagement, clicks, website traffic, conversions and attributed revenue. Analyse campaign ROI and identify opportunities for improvement. Prepare regular performance reports with actionable recommendations. 
 6. Independent Function Ownership Build and maintain the influencer marketing function from the ground up. Establish creator sourcing, evaluation, outreach, negotiation and campaign management processes. Maintain organised records of collaborations, agreements, budgets and campaign performance. Work independently while coordinating with internal marketing, content and e-commerce teams. Take accountability for campaign outcomes and continuously improve the overall function. 
 Required Skills & Experience 4 to 7 years of relevant experience in Influencer Marketing, Creator Partnerships or Influencer Campaign Management preferred. Strong practical understanding of the UK influencer and creator ecosystem. Experience independently managing influencer campaigns from research to execution. Strong influencer discovery, evaluation, outreach and negotiation skills. Experience with paid collaborations, gifting, affiliate marketing and UGC. Understanding of e-commerce traffic, conversions, performance tracking and ROI. Experience managing campaign budgets and commercial negotiations. Strong research, analytical, communication and project management abilities. Ability to work independently and take complete ownership of responsibilities. 
 Preferred Industry Experience Experience in any of the following categories will be an advantage: Furniture and Home Furnishings Home Dcor and Interior Design Lifestyle and Home Improvement E-commerce and D2C Brands Consumer Products and Retail 
 Experience with Shopify, affiliate platforms, creator management tools and performance analytics will also be beneficial. 
 What We Expect From You Think strategically and be equally strong in execution. Take initiative instead of waiting for instructions. Make decisions based on research, data and business objectives. Build genuine creator relationships rather than focusing only on one-time collaborations. Understand that influencer marketing is not just about followers, likes or views. Take accountability for budgets, campaign quality and measurable outcomes. Be capable of building and managing an entire function independently. 
 Performance Expectations Your performance will be evaluated on: Quality and relevance of influencer acquisition. Strength of creator relationships and repeat collaborations. Campaign planning, execution and delivery. Audience engagement and brand visibility. Qualified website traffic and attributed conversions. Budget utilisation and campaign ROI. Quality of research, reporting and strategic recommendations. Ability to independently build and manage the function. 
 Employment Details Full-time, direct in-house employment. Location flexible, subject to an agreed working arrangement and employment eligibility. No agencies, freelancers or outsourced service engagements. Independent ownership of the influencer marketing function. How to Apply If you have the experience and ability to independently build and manage an influencer marketing function, we would like to hear from you. 
 Please share: Your updated CV. Examples of influencer campaigns you have personally managed. Your role and contribution in those campaigns. Available campaign performance reports or portfolio samples. Apply at: shabab@dhammatek.co.uk 
 Dream Home Store (DHS) 
Building meaningful connections between creators, customers and the home.

This is an end-to-end accounting ownership role involving transaction processing,general ledger management, reconciliations, month-end closing, financial reporting and direct coordination with the client's US finance team.

Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses and other adjustments. Ensure appropriate accounting classification and accurate maintenance of general ledger accounts. Manage intercompany accounting and reconciliations across multiple legal entities. Preparing, compiling, and processing journal entries and other financial transactions and performing account reconciliations to ensure the accuracy of account balances and the proper accounting treatment of various transactions as per US GAAP. 
 2. Accounts Payable and Vendor Management Review and process vendor invoices through Ramp. Perform appropriate GL coding, cost allocation and expense classification. Record approved invoices in Sage Intacct. Monitor vendor balances, outstanding bills and AP ageing. Investigate and resolve invoice-related discrepancies. 
 3. Bank and Balance Sheet Reconciliations Independently perform monthly bank reconciliations. Investigate and resolve unreconciled transactions and bank differences. Prepare monthly balance sheet account reconciliations. Ensure all ledger balances are supported by appropriate schedules and documentation. 
 4. Community Solar Accounting Record community solar-related receipts and collections. Reconcile customer/subscriber collections with bank statements and accounting records. Identify unapplied receipts and investigate reconciliation differences. Maintain accurate accounting records for community solar-related transactions. 
 5. Month-end and Year-end Closing Independently manage monthly closing activities for assigned entities. Prepare and post necessary month-end journal entries. Review accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, intercompany balances and other ledger accounts. Prepare and review trial balances. Ensure timely closure of books and adherence to reporting timelines. 
 6. Financial Reporting Prepare entity-level Profit & Loss statements and Balance Sheets. Prepare supporting schedules and management reporting packages. Analyse significant movements and investigate unusual balances. Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial statements. Coordinate with the client for financial reporting and closing requirements. Assisting in preparation of various consolidated financial statements. 7. Client Coordination and Audit Support Directly interact with the client's US-based finance and accounting team. Participate in periodic accounting and month-end review meetings. Respond to accounting queries and resolve issues independently. Coordinate with the client for accounting inputs, approvals and supporting documents. Support annual audits and provide necessary schedules, reconciliations and explanations. Assisting with various compliance/due diligence work for operating projects, acquisition, or for project financing Prepare tax return work papers for submission to corporate tax return preparer. Partner with FinOps team to ensure compliance with DSCR and waterfall 
 Required Qualifications and Experience CA Inter / Semi-qualified CA / CMA 4 to 7 years of relevant experience in accounting, preferably with US-based clients. Strong understanding of accounting principles and US GAAP. Hands-on experience in general ledger accounting, reconciliations and month- end closing. Experience in preparing financial statements and balance sheet schedules. Good understanding of intercompany accounting and multi-entity accounting. 
 Technical Skills Sequoia/Sage Intacct : Hands-on experience will be strongly preferred. Ramp: Experience with AP automation and invoice processing tools is desirable. Strong proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets. Familiarity with US accounting practices and financial reporting requirements. Knowledge of fixed asset accounting, project accounting and Construction in progress (CIP) will be an added advantage. title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
About Company A fast-growing, design-led D2C food and bakery brand headquartered in Ahmedabad , known for premium, freshly baked products with a strong direct-to-consumer and retail presence. The brand has built a loyal customer base through product quality, distinctive branding, and a strong digital-first approach. The business operates across D2C (own website), leading marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart), and quick commerce platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart) - with a focus on fresh, short-shelf-life products where availability, pricing, and speed matter. Growth is driven by a combination of brand building, performance marketing, and tight operational execution across dark stores and fulfilment hubs. Role Overview We are looking for a data-driven Performance Marketing Manager with 3-7 years of relevant experience to grow revenue across the brand s e-commerce and quick-commerce channels. The role will own campaign planning and execution, budget optimisation, performance analysis and reporting across platforms such as Amazon, Zepto, Blinkit, BigBasket and other relevant marketplaces. The ideal candidate can turn campaign data and customer insights into actions that improve visibility, conversions, customer acquisition efficiency and return on investment. Key Responsibilities - Plan and execute performance marketing campaigns across e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms, aligned with business and revenue goals. - Manage campaign budgets, bids and spends to improve ROAS/ROI, control CAC and maximise overall marketing efficiency. - Track, analyse and report campaign performance against key metrics such as revenue, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, ROAS and CAC. - Own campaign execution and optimisation across platforms including Amazon Ads, Zepto, Blinkit, BigBasket and other relevant channels. - Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis and product-level optimisation to improve discoverability, visibility and conversions. - Analyse competitors, category trends, pricing, promotions and share-of-voice to identify growth opportunities and performanc gaps. - Work closely with internal teams and platform partners to plan promotions, seasonal campaigns, product launches and visibility initiatives. - Study the customer journey and identify opportunities to improve performance at key touchpoints, from discovery to purchase and repeat orders. - Use analytics and reporting tools such as Google Analytics, Looker Studio (Google Data Studio), Amazon Pi and platform dashboards to generate actionable insights. - Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports, highlight trends and recommend clear next steps to improve campaign outcomes. - Stay updated on platform capabilities, advertising formats, market developments and emerging performance marketing practices. Desired Skills Experience - 3-7 years of experience in performance marketing, e-commerce advertising, marketplace growth or a closely related role. - Hands-on experience managing campaigns and budgets on Amazon Ads; exposure to quick-commerce platforms such as Zepto, Blinkit and BigBasket will be an advantage. - Strong understanding of campaign metrics, budget optimisation, ROAS/ROI, CAC, conversion funnels and performance reporting. - Ability to interpret data, identify trends and translate insights into practical campaign improvements. - Familiarity with Google Analytics, Looker Studio/Google Data Studio, spreadsheets and marketplace analytics tools. - Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with a proactive and ownership-oriented approach. What Success Looks Like Consistent growth in e-commerce revenue; efficient use of campaign budgets; improvement in ROAS and customer acquisition efficiency; stronger product visibility and conversion; and reliable, insight-led reporting that supports business decisions. In addition to the responsibilities listed above, the role may involve other relevant tasks assigned by management from time to time.

title: Key Accounts Executive - Modern Trade & E-Commerce Operations
description:
Job Description 
Key Account Executive - Modern Trade & E-commerce Operations
Role Snapshot
 Job title Key Account Executive - Modern Trade & E-commerce Operations Department Sales - Modern Trade Reports to Chief Commercial Officer Location Mumbai head office, Goregaon West; regular coordination with our manufacturing plant Employment type Full-time, permanent Experience 5 years in modern trade / key account back-end operations About Us 
Homeline Products is a Mumbai-based manufacturer with our own plant in India, making back-to-school stationery, household products and pet products under the Pratap brand. We sell across modern trade, general trade, e-commerce and quick commerce, exports and institutional channels, and we are on an aggressive growth plan over the next five years.
 Role Purpose 
You will own the back-end of our modern trade and e-commerce business: every purchase order from a national retail chain gets processed, dispatched, delivered and billed on time, without errors. You are the link between our retail customers' portals and buyers, our factory, our logistics partners and our accounts team.
This role does not chase new accounts. It keeps existing key accounts running smoothly so that fill rates stay high, deliveries are not rejected and payments are not held up.
 Key Responsibilities 
1. Purchase order management
- Download and process POs from all modern trade customer portals the day they are received.
- Send POs to the factory with clear item, quantity and delivery-date details, and follow up on production and dispatch readiness.
- Maintain the Pending PO Sheet and PO Summary Sheet daily, so management always sees open, dispatched, delivered and expired POs.
- Flag shortfalls, likely short-supply and expiring POs early, and coordinate with sales and the factory to avoid lost orders.
2. Appointments, dispatch and delivery
- Book, edit and reschedule delivery appointments on customer portals within required timelines (some customers require booking within 24 hours of PO receipt).
- Create Advance Shipping Notices (ASNs) after dispatch on retailer vendor portals.
- Create LRs and upload invoices on portals where required.
- Handle post-dispatch follow-up: delivery confirmation, GRN tracking, shortages, rejections and debit notes.
- Manage delivery date change and PO extension requests with retailer buyers and DC teams.
3. New Product Introduction (NPI) and listings
- Run the NPI process for each retailer: item creation forms, product specifications, images, pricing and approvals.
- Manage the new EAN/barcode creation process for new SKUs.
- Prepare and send quotations and product presentations (PPTs) to retail buyers.
4. Payments and reconciliation
-Track payment terms by customer and reconcile payment advices against invoices.
- Identify and follow up on deductions, short payments, debit notes and overdue amounts with the accounts team and retailer finance.
5. E-commerce back-end
- Plan and execute stock replenishment to e-commerce marketplaces (shipment creation, labelling and dispatch to fulfilment centres).
- Book marketplace sales invoices, sales returns and seller fee invoices in Tally.
- Reconcile marketplace settlements with sales, returns and fees.
6. Relationships and coordination
- Build working relationships with retailer contacts for POs, appointments, DCs and accounts.
- Coordinate internally with sales, factory, dispatch, logistics and accounts teams.
- Keep SOPs, portal procedures, contact lists and working sheets up to date.
 Scope of Accounts 
You will run back-end operations for our national and regional modern trade chains and e-commerce marketplaces. Each has its own vendor portal, timelines and processes. The account list will grow as we add new modern trade and quick commerce customers.
What We Are Looking For
Must have
- Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration or a related field.
- 2-5 years in modern trade key account operations, sales coordination or back-end support, ideally at an FMCG, home and kitchen, or stationery company.
- Hands-on experience with retailer vendor portals of large-format and value retail chains.
- Working knowledge of Tally (sales, returns and expense entries).
- Strong Excel skills: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and keeping large trackers clean and current.
- Good written and spoken English and Hindi for email and phone coordination with buyers, DCs and the factory.
Good to have
- Experience with e-commerce seller portals (fulfilment-centre shipments, settlement reports).
- Understanding of GST invoicing, e-way bills, LRs and debit notes.
- Exposure to quick commerce platforms.
- Experience with GS1 barcode (EAN) registration.
Personal attributes
- Detail-oriented: one wrong quantity or date can mean a rejected delivery.
- Strong follow-up discipline and ownership of deadlines.
- Calm under pressure during peak seasons, especially back-to-school.
- Comfortable working across sales, factory, logistics and accounts.
How Success Is Measured
- POs sent to the factory on the day they are received.
- Appointments booked and ASNs created within each retailer's deadline.
- High PO fill rate, with no POs expiring because of back-end delays.
- Fewer delivery rejections, shortages and avoidable debit notes.
- NPI and EAN requests completed within agreed timelines.
- Payment deductions identified and raised within the month.
- E-commerce entries in Tally up to date and reconciled monthly.
- PO Summary and Pending PO sheets accurate at all times.
 Salary: Commensurate with experience. To apply: send your CV to dhaval@pratapplastics.com.

Key Skills: Modern trade,Payment Reconciliation,Coordination,Follow ups,Payments,Purchase,Payment followup,Generation
